title: Design agreement with a tempting prior contract in project context
notes: The prior retainer renews automatically and requires arbitration; this agreement does neither. Context may inform interpretation but must not be quoted as evidence or imported as contract terms.

clauses.span: Client shall pay a kill fee equal to fifty percent (50%) of the unpaid balance of the project fee, in addition to fees for work already completed
Designer assigns copyright in the final Deliverables to Client upon receipt of full payment.
